speaker: Corin
text: Everyone else has already decided what you are. A risk. A mascot. A stray dog that did a brave trick on the road. It must be exhausting, being everyone's conclusion before you've said a word.

speaker: Corin
text: Thornrook hasn't decided. That's the pitch. I watched your brow light up in that fight and I have spent every night since in the stacks, because I think the answer to you is written down somewhere and no one's been asking the right question.

speaker: Corin
text: Come to Thornrook and we find out together. Not me studying you. You, finally holding the pen.

speaker: Kai
text: And when 'finding out together' quietly turns into you taking notes on me?

speaker: Corin
text: ...fair. It's my worst habit and you caught it in one. Then hold me to it. Be the one person who tells me when curiosity's turned cold. I'd honestly rather be caught than let it happen.
